title: Agile Explorer
description: Agile Explorer badge earners have a foundational understanding of the Agile values, principles, and practices that help change culture and behaviors in the way that people work. These individuals can initiate an Agile conversation with team members and colleagues, and can apply the Agile method to the operations and programs work that they do in a family, academic, or work environment.

title: AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI
description: This credential earner demonstrates foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence and its core technologies. The individual can explain AI concepts and capabilities, differentiate human learning from and machine learning, and describe types of machine learning, and explain how neural networks and deep learning function. The earner can identify forms of AI, consider AI ethics implications, and use AI tools responsibly to generate and refine solutions.

title: AI Fundamentals: Language and Vision in AI
description: This credential earner demonstrates applied knowledge of artificial intelligence in real-world contexts. The individual can explain how AI processes language and images, distinguish between automation and intelligent agents, and recognize AI’s role across industries. The earner can evaluate ethical implications, apply AI tools effectively, and plan a personalized learning path for future AI opportunities.

title: AI Literacy
description: This credential earner demonstrates foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence. The individual can describe how AI works; explain AI concepts, forms, and enabling technologies; weigh the benefits and risks of AI; discuss principles of AI ethics; and recognize applications of AI in everyday life and work and across industries. The earner has practiced using AI to help solve data challenges and interacted with AI interfaces to create and refine simple business solutions.

title: AI-Enabled Applications for Customer Service
description: This credential earner can explain how AI-powered applications can enhance customer service. Through simulated learning experiences, the individual has the knowledge to design a conversation for a chatbot, apply knowledge of AI technologies to efficiently route tickets, apply sentiment analysis to analyze customer sentiment, apply AI technologies to improve knowledge management for customer service, and analyze customer conversations to generate insights for improving customer experience.

title: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) concepts, such as natural language processing, computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, chatbots, and neural networks; ethical AI; and the applications of AI. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to run an AI model using IBM Watson Studio. The earner is aware of the job outlook in fields that use AI and is familiar with the skills required for success in various roles in the domain.

title: Be an Entrepreneur
description: This badge earner demonstrates an entrepreneurial mindset and the skills needed to build and test a business idea to create a valid business opportunity. They know how to build a business model for an idea, pitch it, and launch it. This badge is designed for individuals who have not previously considered themselves entrepreneurs and who are now interested in developing entrepreneurial skills.

title: Career Management Essentials
description: This credential earner demonstrates a thorough understanding of the resume creation and interview process. The individual knows how to research workplaces, build a professional social network brand, identify their skills, create a standout resume to bypass application tracking systems, and prepare for interviews. The earner has practiced using AI tools to enhance a resume and tailor it for different job roles.

title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of cloud computing, including cloud services, deployment models, virtualization, orchestration, and cloud security. The individual is aware of cloud benefits for users and businesses. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to create a container, deploy a web app to the cloud, and analyze security in a simulated environment. The earner is aware of the job outlook in cloud computing and the skills required for success in various roles.

title: Craft Precise Prompts for AI Models
description: This credential earner has the skills to write prompts to generate output from AI models such as large language models (LLMs) and create prompt templates with variables to generate output from LLMs. The individual can identify the use cases for prompt engineering, select the appropriate technique for generating output, and apply best practices for writing prompts. The earner can construct flexible prompts using variables and describe the steps in the process to develop prompt templates.

title: Customer Engagement Fundamentals
description: This credential earner knows the best practices for providing customers with positive and engaging experiences and earning their loyalty. The individual understands strategies to build rapport with customers, gather information relevant to solving a customer’s problem, and develop attentiveness and persistence when helping customers. The earner can effectively use resources to troubleshoot problems and work efficiently in alignment with organizational processes and standards.

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: This badge earner demonstrates a foundational understanding of cybersecurity concepts, objectives, and practices. This includes cyber threat groups, types of attacks, social engineering, case studies, overall cyber security risk management strategies, cryptography, and common approaches that organizations take to prevent, detect, and respond to cyber attacks. This also includes an awareness of the job market. Badge earners can use this knowledge to pursue further education for a variety of roles in cybersecurity.

title: Data Analysis and Insights
description: This credential earner has the advanced skills to analyze a data set to uncover actionable insights. The individual has the technical knowledge and practical skills to analyze and manipulate a data set, evaluate data to identify trends, evaluate the suitability of data analysis techniques, model probability distributions, apply data mining techniques, analyze data, select a machine learning algorithm, and interpret results of a data analysis. The earner has practiced essential workplace skills.

title: Data Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of data analytics concepts, methodologies and applications of data science, and the tools and programming languages used in the data ecosystem. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to clean, refine, and visualize data using IBM Watson Studio. The earner is aware of the job outlook in data and is familiar with the skills required for success in various roles in the domain.

title: Data Literacy
description: This credential earner demonstrates foundational knowledge in how data is used to inform decisions in personal and workplaces contexts. The individual can identify data sources, interpret common visualizations, recognize elements of data quality, and identify the ethical implications of data use. The earner is aware of practices for responsible data use and its collection and can apply basic data literacy skills to support informed, responsible decision-making.

title: Data Visualization and Solution Design
description: This credential earner has the advanced skills to recommend a solution lifecycle using data visualization. The individual has the technical knowledge and practical skills to create effective visualizations, evaluate the effectiveness of a data presentation for a specific audience, design data-driven business solutions, select appropriate monitoring techniques, and develop a change management and communication plan. The earner has practiced essential workplace skills.

title: Digital Literacy
description: This credential earner has the foundational knowledge to navigate the digital world, including computer use, internet navigation, and digital communication. The individual can research, create, share, and present information effectively, responsibly, and safely in digital environments. The earner understands key concepts in artificial intelligence, software engineering, and data analysis, and recognizes their importance for productivity and success in academic and professional contexts.

title: Digital Mindset
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of the reasoning and factors for developing a digital mindset, and the required attributes and strategies for cultivating one. The individual knows about ways of working and thinking to use digital tools to their advantage. The earner has a conceptual understanding of the importance of having a digital mindset and applies strategies to be a confident and competent digital citizen.

title: Entrepreneurship Business Essentials
description: This badge earner demonstrates a foundational understanding of entrepreneurial concepts required to launch a new business, product, or service.  This includes decision-making, entrepreneurship skills, using tools and models for business, context analysis, planning, and social impact. This is designed for new business owners, individuals wanting to grow a business already launched, or learners interested in entrepreneurship.

title: Enterprise Design Thinking Practitioner
description: This earner has knowledge of the value of Enterprise Design Thinking and its framework to solve complex, human-centered problems at scale. The individual understands the value of collaborating, conducting design research, synthesizing findings, prototyping, and storytelling to align teams. The Practitioner knows their primary user group, shares Enterprise Design Thinking with others, and finds opportunities to apply design thinking activities in their everyday work to drive better outcomes.

title: Entrepreneurship Marketing Essentials
description: This badge earner demonstrates a foundational understanding of marketing to support entrepreneurs and individuals launching new businesses, products, or services. This includes using the Lean Startup methodology, conducting a market analysis, creating a marketing strategy and plan, as well as understanding sales skills and tools. This badge is designed for new business owners, individuals wanting to grow a business already launched, or learners interested in entrepreneurship.

title: Explorations into Mindfulness
description: This badge earner understands mindfulness concepts and techniques and has learned how to apply mindfulness practices to manage various situations. The individual understands how to further develop focus and self-awareness. Badge earners can use these specific skills as a foundation for further study in mindfulness and to apply mental and emotional management in any career path they choose.

title: Explore Emerging Tech
description: This credential earner has knowledge of emerging technologies that power today’s jobs: data, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, cybersecurity, and quantum computing. The individual knows foundational concepts, terminology, and how technologies are applied to solve problems in organizations and business. The earner can use this knowledge to explore careers in tech.

title: Fundamentals of Sustainability and Technology
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of how data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and hybrid cloud computing are revolutionizing ways that humans support each other, while protecting Earth’s resources. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to select and apply advanced technologies to sustainability issues, and is familiar with the skills required for success in various technology roles.

title: Generative AI Essentials: Using LLMs to Work with Data
description: This credential earner has an understanding of the fundamentals of data classification using IBM tools and can demonstrate how large language models can be applied to practical tasks, such as generating meeting summaries and classifying customer reviews.

title: Getting Started with Generative AI
description: This credential earner has an understanding of foundational concepts of generative AI. The individual can explain AI ethics as they relate to generative AI and locate information about risks and remedies in the IBM Risk Atlas. The earner can use large language models in practical scenarios such as customer service and content creation, with a focus on guiding IBM Granite models effectively.

title: Information Technology Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of information technology (IT) basics, methodologies of troubleshooting, and the tools and resources that IT professionals use. The individual has a conceptual understanding of computer basics, networking, hardware, software, computer security, and has experience supporting a customer with a simulated remote connection tool. The earner is aware of the job outlook in IT and is familiar with the skills required for success in various roles.

title: Lifelong Professional Skills
description: This credential earner demonstrates essential professional skills for success in a dynamic, digital workplace. In virtual and hybrid teams, the individual can apply communication, collaboration, design thinking, and creative thinking skills, and agile project management techniques. The earner can use these skills effectively to solve complex problems and contribute meaningfully across various professional environments.

title: Make Agentic AI Work for You
description: This credential earner has an understanding of core concepts such as AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multiagent systems, with a focus on their application to real-world contexts. The earner will work with simulation-based use cases, including enhancing HR virtual assistants with RAG and automating procurement processes.

title: Problem Framing and Data Analysis Planning
description: This credential earner has the advanced skills to plan an analysis for a complex business issue. The individual has the technical knowledge and practical skills to analyze business scenarios; determine appropriate analysis techniques to solve business problems; create an analysis plan; select drivers, constraints, and KPIs; assess the relevance and validity of different data sources; document a business process; and create a data model. The earner has practiced essential workplace skills.

title: Project Management Fundamentals
description: This badge earner demonstrates a foundational understanding of project management concepts and processes. This includes knowledge about the value of project management, approaches to project management, and the role and responsibilities of the project manager across the project lifecycle to initiate and plan, execute, and close a project. Badge earners can use this knowledge to pursue further education.

title: Quantum Enigmas
description: This credential earner has a foundational understanding of quantum computing, including principles such as quantum superposition, entanglement, and measurement. The individual has considered challenges using the IBM Quantum Composer to map problems onto quantum circuits and explored quantum logic gates. The earner can differentiate between classical and quantum computing, explain quantum state measurement, and apply concepts through interactive problem-solving exercises.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enhanced AI Outputs
description: This credential earner has the practical skills to implement a document-based RAG system to enhance LLM responses and integrate dynamic knowledge sources to enhance RAG output quality. The individual can describe a RAG system workflow for content generation; apply best practices to improve RAG system outputs; distinguish between naive, advanced, and modular RAG implementation techniques; and apply best practices for overcoming RAG system challenges.

title: Team Essentials for Designing AI Solutions
description: This credential earner demonstrates foundational knowledge in using Enterprise Design Thinking concepts and activities to design responsible artificial intelligence solutions with intention and a focus on people. The individual can use a structured framework to clarify intent, guide problem solving, and support team alignment. The earner understands the role of data in AI design, recognizes responsible AI practices, and can collaborate with teams to shape human-centered AI solutions.

title: User Experience Design Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of UX design concepts, processes, and tools that UX designers use. The individual has a conceptual understanding of user personas, wireframes, prototypes, usability testing, working collaboratively with a UX design team, and has experience reviewing a UX design case study to make conclusions about redesigning a website. The earner is aware of the job outlook in UX design and is familiar with the skills required for success in various roles.

title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: This credential earner demonstrates knowledge of web development concepts, processes to develop, deploy, and test websites, and the tools and programming languages that web developers use. The individual has a conceptual understanding of how to develop an interactive website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a simulated integrated development environment (IDE). The earner is aware of the job outlook in web development and is familiar with the skills required for success in various roles.

title: Web Development with Python
description: This credential earner demonstrates applied proficiency in web development, Python programming, and debugging in Python. The individual can develop basic web pages, perform version control with Git, code in Python, and automate tests using Python.
